Name: FastosoZ's Maru portrait fixed
Author: ciafey
Description:
An edit of FastosoZ's Maru to make Maru look like how she looks in her original portrait. This was just a quick and simple edit to the skin and hair, I just overlayed the picture with a color and added her glasses. I don't plan on doing other characters as this was just for fun and I like to edit random stuff.

I edited the content patcher version which you can download [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-117#post-3348345]here[/url]

place the maru png files into " [CP] FastosoZ's Portraits > Assets " and replace the original png files in that folder with the new ones

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/616]Original mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38879130]FastosoZ[/url]

If anyone wants to for fun, check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6904]Pusheen mod edit[/url]
